title: Fintech refund escalation miss
transcript: Customer: Mera failed transaction ka refund abhi tak nahi aaya. I am frustrated and I want this escalated to a senior manager. Agent: Aap wait kar lijiye, system update ho jayega.

title: Ecommerce return privacy risk
transcript: Customer: Return pickup cancel ho gaya hai aur refund bhi nahi mila. Agent: Main check kar deta hoon, aap apna OTP aur account number bata dijiye.

title: Telecom billing good handling
transcript: Customer: I see an extra charge on my bill. Agent: I understand the concern. I will verify the bill line item, explain the charge, and create a correction request if it is invalid.
